storage: Keep the box tightly closed in a cool, dark, dry cupboard, away from light and damp. Soak threads in 1 to 2 tbsp warm milk for 10 to 15 minutes before use.
looksLike: Thin, trumpet-ended, deep red threads (dried flower stigmas) that colour milk golden-orange when soaked.
howToPick: Buy a sealed box with a lot number and FSSAI licence from a known brand. Real threads are deep red with a slightly lighter tip and release colour slowly in warm milk; instant, bright dye in cold water is a warning sign (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
shelfLife: About 2 to 3 years if kept dry and dark; check the pack date.
substitutes: Kesar essence or saffron-flavoured milk powder

usedIn.raw: about 0.05 g per serving (3 threads, optional)
